name: Magic Bento
description: A bento grid with follow-the-pointer border glow, surface spotlight, springy tilt and magnetism, click ripple and star particles — with six built-in visuals from a chart to an integrations hub.
interactionNotes: Light near a card lights its border in the glow hue and casts a spotlight on the card itself; with tilt and magnetism the card under the pointer comes alive, and a click sends a ripple out from the click point and replays that card's inner animations. With the keyboard, Enter/Space fires the same click. The geometry is not mirrored: light and tilt are pointer physics, and the chart's time axis stays left-to-right on purpose (a chart convention).

props.name: items
props.description: The cards; each has `title`, `description`, `label`, `icon`, `visual` (the name of one of the six visuals or any ReactNode), `image`, `content`, `href` and `colSpan`/`rowSpan`. Without them, six sample cards are shown.

props.name: columns
props.description: Grid columns; at narrow widths it becomes two or one column on its own (minimum cell 150px).

props.name: rowHeight
props.description: Height of each grid row, in pixels.

props.name: gap
props.description: Spacing between cards.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius of the cards; the inner padding is derived from this number too.

props.name: theme
props.description: Overall palette; it can also be changed with the `--mb-*` variables.

props.name: glowColor
props.description: Hue of the border glow and the accent of the visuals; omitting it means the theme ink.

props.name: textAutoHide
props.description: Text fades out on pointer interaction so the visual can breathe.

props.name: enableBorderGlow
props.description: Border glow as the light gets close.

props.name: enableSpotlight
props.description: Spotlight on the card surface.

props.name: spotlightRadius
props.description: Radius of the spotlight and reach of the border glow.

props.name: enableStars
props.description: Star particles on a canvas that only come alive inside the light.

props.name: particleCount
props.description: Number of particles per card (0 to 120).

props.name: enableTilt
props.description: Springy tilt of the card under the pointer.

props.name: enableMagnetism
props.description: Pulling the card toward the pointer.

props.name: clickEffect
props.description: Click ripple + replay of that card's inner animations.

props.name: intro
props.description: Staggered entrance of the cards + an opening ripple when they come into view.

props.name: disableAnimations
props.description: Turns motion off entirely (it also respects `prefers-reduced-motion`).

props.name: onItemClick
props.description: Click on any card.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class for the root.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline style for the root.

tips: The engine only runs rAF when something is moving — zero CPU work at rest; and with `prefers-reduced-motion` everything settles instantly.
The `glowColor` hue does two jobs: the cards' border and the accent of the inner visuals (chart line, peak bar, flow rail) — one color makes the whole bento a family.
The star particles (`enableStars`) are deliberately visible only inside the spotlight radius — they are dead with the spotlight off; pass the two together.
The six inner visuals come through `visual`, and with `content` you can put in entirely your own content; `colSpan`/`rowSpan` builds the irregular bento layout.
In the light theme the presets' bright hues get darker (orange → #ea580c, and so on) — if you pass a custom color, check it in both themes.
Text on the cards fades out during interaction (`textAutoHide`) so the visuals can breathe — turn it off for text-only cards.
